god-is-one.title: Nyasae Nonyi Omogoseti
god-is-one.summary: Tigana na goseemania Ekitabu Ekirangani Echiekaro enyinche y’omonyasae omonyi atari gosekeriana.

0.title: Tigana na echiekaro
0.explanation: Ekitabu eki chindete gosebuza Abaisiraeli kobwatia kwonyora Nyasae o obotonda obokora. Ekionera bo otechuruteki: TENDEKENI, ABAISRAELI: NYASAE WABO AGA NYASAEE OMOKA. Erongori eye ekerende egesike g’ogotioma gose sidoko sesiago. Kiana kiorangete okobwateka mo Nyasae agokorania, er spirit, Obwateki bwa Abaacha, Omwana, kana ekereero kiaaye ki Kristo, chionserete chiekaro ching’ina esiki gose kolekoria.
0.hook: Deuteronomy etuhiagia echiekaro: Nyasae nobere omonyi. Ekitabu kirende ekibangaina asege borangeti boriete. Isaiah 43:10 ebuza nenai kerende Nyasae ekionene ko gose okorire omoke omoyio agokire.

1.title: Tari Nyasae omogezire ing'aini, kana ogende igoro
1.explanation: Nyasae atugwatia ching’ina: taro Nyasae oyio akorire ing’aini, tara ng’ina arete ogende igoro. Okoroteria omote ekiongo okore chioragania Nyasae oyio. Nyasae etikorie omote obokora gose abagokora Nyasae. Nyasae tari omowarara o erindo ya Nyasae. Nyasae numo, tara kiorogetie, tara omonye Nyasae banake ing’aini ya aye.
1.hook: Egochera Nyasae ing’aini ya aye, na ogende igoro. Kiomento naigwe ni ng’ina ing’aini ekionene ko ere, korwa erinde. Isaiah 44:8 etorokeria ekirango egetie.

2.title: Tari Nyasae hambanyi naye
2.explanation: Nyasae abuza ko erinde Nyasae hambanyi nabwo, na agosubota: tobogerie ing’aina erinde na akokwabera. Ekitabu china ng’aki kokorania neboture kerinde abaegokora abane. Nyasae okwerokia kiorogetie Nyasae hambanyi naye. Monotheism y’ekitabu eki ere egesike gose hibanduko y’ekosebaka. Ching’ina ekitabu chinaga Nyasae omonyi, tara omote omonye Nyasae hambanyi naye.
2.hook: Abamonene b’ekitabu basichie kerinde moistoki. Tore tocha New Testament: Jesu akomanya ekirangani chave? Mark 12:29 agranania chingo.

3.title: Jesu agererera Shema y’Abaisiraeli
3.explanation: Jesu akonyana echiekaro ch’eng’ina y’Abaisiraeli: "Tendekeni, Abaisiraeli; Nyasae wabo noga Nyasae omoka." Takerokerie Shema y’Abaisiraeli na ekirango ekieko ekieronde goko ekionde eke omokire ing’aini ya aye. Ekere bata Eshemia ekirango kia Nyasae omonyi asegeseng’e topongoru ekirango ekieko. Ese ng’ina y’ekristiano kerinde Jesu eigwa ase egesike, tirinse kiorogasira chinekio korwa Jesu ayoke ebwererie.
3.hook: Jesu agererera ekirango kia Nyasae omoka. Tikere kiomento kiagokora nigo abapostori batorokereria chiemo chingo. Paul akwana ekirango ase 1 Corinthians 8:4.

4.title: Abapostori batorokereria
4.explanation: Paul akora abakorintho kerinde tari Nyasae iragete omonyi. Egokorania ayeke arete egesike Nyasae omonyi, nyaise, na Omwami Jesu Kristo, bona igorania. Tindaini ekirango ching’ina chakwa makora. Eteaching y’Apostolic Oneness igwati mo ekirango eki chibanene cha Paul ekionde, naigete Jesu noso kore kionera Nyasae oyio ogotabera, igorwa riane Abakristo bakorania mo abacha na Omwana barorania.
4.hook: Ekirango chiegwa taya korwa Moses, abamonene, na Jesu, ne abapostori ase ekarere ki’Ekristo. Oko otarorera, pathway eye erengia chingo ase Ekitabu chinene chiagwatia chiane onchenu tari erinde, hambanyi, ing’aini, kana ogende igoro ya Nyasae.

no-god-beside-him.title: Ngoina Igoro Omoiganaire Bwakwe
no-god-beside-him.summary: Gokora amagokonya ya Ebibilia ereta okobwatoka kora igoro, oboirete, kochiara, oborora, kana ogokora otenire eya LORD obokabwatiire ounyinyi bw’omogusii.

0.title: Tegere N’obairete Bwakwe
0.explanation: LORD agosirira Abaisraeli na okobwate omogoko goyaire: Yeye ase ogoteba n’ayaiga ki: Yeye ase Igoro, kandi teokorire omwaini oboirete Bwakwe. Eri oyo n’tegendi okwereti okomanya goyaire ga Abaisraeli oborigi kose ching’ombe ch’obokong’ani. Moses agosirira kokorigereria okorigeria kwa moya n’omogusii. Oria mbere gokosoma igokwa Yesu, mwandiki arakwaning’a ekogwa ki gosiori obotchana chonyore.
0.hook: Deuteronomy 4:35 egosiori tere oboirete. Gosiori gokweronda ing’a: Kobe Ngai agosiori igoro nying’o yagereire naye?

1.title: Tegere N’omoragori Naye
1.explanation: Erisomano rya Moses, LORD agosiori ki: ase Igoro, kandi tegere Ngai nayi. Agokorora ogokwate ogwatinda eokong’o, ekweri, n’omorora, n’egotiberia. Omogoko ogwo n’tegendi oyio Ngai Ekeraite yarikia naye, erinde, iye n’ayio ore oramatonda riao, ogoteba teokorire omoragori naye. Ong’ina oyo neyeseteri ebande goyosoma igokwa Yesu n’ekero Ngai ogokorora ogwatinda Yesu.
1.hook: Deuteronomy 32:39 egotanga o Ngai ku ereta rya Ngai. Isaiah 43:10 egotambura igo bochiara: tegere mbere and tegere oborora.

2.title: Tegere Mberere kana Oborora
2.explanation: Ogendo arorera Abaisraeli eng’o abachongera, LORD agosiori ki: tegere Ngai ekere mberere, tegere oborora Ngai okabwatiire. Enchera ogwo y’ekemanyi n’atari Ngai nyomo okonyora kori mo ching’ombe kana ndire y’ekegusii. Ogosiori ogwa Christus egotebesa nyaroka Ngai nyomo bwandiki, ndire okobwate omogusii wandiki ire, niyo Christ akonyora uno Ngai, tegendi si ng’a Abaisraeli agosokerie Ngai omoswi.
2.hook: Isaiah egosiori omogusii tegere mberere, tegere oborora LORD. Isaiah 44:6 egosirira ogosiori ogwo n’omobokania: LORD osi First na Last kandi egosiori tegere Ngai oboirete Bwakwe.

3.title: First, Last, na Ngai Yayaigo
3.explanation: LORD agosiori Yeye ng’a Mosacha wa Abaisraeli na Mokong’anisi, First na Last, kandi egosiori tegere Ngai oboirete Bwakwe. Amateri are, n’aretweria gotindana kw’oroteria bwakwe na ekobwate ogotokanirania ogoriete Ngai esendi. Ojorete na Yesu, ekegokoma aroriere, egosirira kindoki ekemanyi eigoro. Iri kori omware, oyio ore ogwa omobokania na Yesu, enyamari y’Obunge eya Old Testament etetoka oka.
3.hook: Amahere o'marote egosiora. O'gokenderia, ekegosoma ng'a apostolic church yachiria ogosiori oyo ekerorera Yesu?

4.title: Ekorigeria y’Apostolic
4.explanation: Paul agosomia ekobwate y’Abaisraeli egosiria tegere Ngai oboirete. Versi 6 eigosoma Ngai ndobo, Baba, na Yesu Christus, oyio orotindo tibosa. Pauliti ndirina abere ng’a ng’a amahobe abere arinde, tegendi Trinitarian kana Oneness abere arinde. Ogosoma omware, ekegosoma yawa Baba na Yesu Christus okwa enda gotebereirania egoro? Ekorigereri y’Apostolic Oneness egotebesa Yesu omoiganaire Nyasae oria ring’a n’obobunde bwa muntu.
4.hook: Abasomi b’ekorigeria babosire ogosiori Nyasae oyio. Oyio, kenda ekeng’ania: ng’a oyio Nyasae n’konyora ekere yayaigo?

god-alone-creator.title: Enyasa Egeri Otong'ani Nyasae
god-alone-creator.summary: Tegera gochi omosacha Nyasae gotonga enyasa egento ekegendererwe n’Ekegusii Nyagetokia gotara Kristo.

0.title: Omotongana Okarakwana Enyasa
0.explanation: Ekitabu ky’Egesi Ekobwa Genesis kineneete Nyasae gotonga omotongana okarakwana enyasa n’echinche ch’ogusaisi. Ekyio tibiragocheti ne Nyasae ebwate akorano igoro n’agotonga, korende ase ogotoma orogendo rwebwe, omotongana ogwamisaria. Tirina gotebere nyasa igoro n’abagwatia gyei, nigo gonene ching’airire nyasa Nyasae gotara enyasa egeri ekobwate eng’ania. Eyio enyoresa baiseni buna Ebuku Egesonto Ekeenge ekebwakire ebisacha ebya Kristo n’Amagano ogwa Nyasae ne gotoreka enyasa.
0.hook: Genesis yayaika Nyasae gotonga otong'ani ogotere enyasa. Isaiah akoreka Nyasae oromanania ekegendererwe enyoreru kusacha bw’akora enyasa n'obokibwate wondoke nabw’akora nabo.

1.title: Akarakwana enyasa abwone
1.explanation: Ase chibesa chino, Nyasae oromania atwekireti abwate ogotong'a obwone, okwereng’a ching’ania ogotogete aende n’akora enyasa getaka monosimo n’okobwone. Tibieringeero are ang’ania gotera nabw’akora omulokoachie. Tibierara gotong’a bwa akora enyasa ogw’okobakora n’omonyasa gage baingo. Okobatira Maandiko gotamba John 1 n’Colossians 1, niko nabeire nayore gotora ebisacha byabwo abwatie gose gebare ekoyorane ekebwate Nyasae okebwate ogotong’a obwone.
1.hook: Nyasae atwekireti okobwone akoreka enyasa gose gostrech’a amanyasa. Nageriria ne amaang’ani ase Ebyamaiso are ki kwanga ekerandi egosacha gotara Ekegeni Kyigweyo ne Eriancha eke.

2.title: Nyasae okooneka enyasa n’Ekarai y’Ekorora ke
2.explanation: Emori ese yamanyasa yagenderera Nyasae gose goye akerandi gotong’ani: mayasa aichorete n'Ekarai yokorora ke n’omokebwakia eke ekobwate ebichacho by’egetiki eke. Okorora Nyasae gokoratia ebiasachie; ching’eria tibyakorwa n'omonyasa onde. Kio nikio kigarurira John 1 ase Enyasa Egenteke Ekisi Ekebwate Amaraso. Emori ese yamanyasa tire na gose gotiga amasacharo gelegwa ekebwate Omorogiame n’Ekarai, egwabera goteba gokorora Nyasae nikio kionai gotamba Nyasae gotong’a abwone.
2.hook: Emori ese yamanyasa ekora gokorora Nyasae gose gokorwa n’Ekarai y’Ekorora y’abwone ekegendererwe ching’ania. John 1 ekoyia rirende riria nigo ekosoma enyora ching’ania egento enyoreru Ebuku ekobwate amagano.

3.title: Ebintu byosi bikorwa n’Ekarai
3.explanation: John aema ba ebintu byosi bikorwa n’Ekarai, na ogokora kitari bikorobwa nikio tibyatorana okonyora Ekarai. Ekarai tigo okatarwa n’ebirimo ebya gotorwa. Genesis na Isaiah bigarurira Nyasae gotara enyasa; John ototoma gose Ekarai Nyasae, na atwekireti Ekarai yaba omonto. Ekenyena Ekegendererwe Ekyegusii ketabania enyora esacha ese: Nyasae gotong'a enyasa nigo arete ekonyora Kristo, tibia Kristo aria mong’ane na Nyasae gotara enyasa ching’ania eke.
3.hook: John oyia tibirimo kikorwa korete Ekarai. Colossians otsotera gose gokorwa Kristo enyoreru.

4.title: Ebintu byosi ne bikorwa Kristo omonene
4.explanation: Paulo aema ba ebintu byosi omokora aibere n’Ekerende n’Ekegusii, bikorobwa Kristo n’omonene, ne bokwate egetiki n’endwaro yae. Kio kitirambagiriri Kristo gotorwena chikero chia gotorwa. Isaiah 44:24 atwekireti Nyasae gotong’a ebintu byosi abwone, eyio enyorani nikio kionai kogenda gotora ebiyaria John 1 na Colossians 1. Ekenyena Ekegendererwe Ekyegusii eligora omonkano wa Nyasae ebwate Kristo gotonga Enyasa ogwone, yayaika Paulo ekotora Kristo n’enyasa yomanene, ne ebirimo biria birererania, tire be kweria kochaga ose gotiga embwati y’ebiyaria by’abwo.
4.hook: Ebuku Eng'irisi Ekebwate Amagana gotora Kristo enyora Enyasa ogwone n’ebitwa bye. Getomera ne sambusa erieta yorisania Kristo n’omonene?

jesus-is-god.title: Yeso Nigo Nyasae
jesus-is-god.summary: Donya kogoseta ebia eng'ania Kristo Yesu nigo Nyasae tontore, ungaendeete ebia eng'erete Bibiria kutegania ikore.

0.title: Obochania bwa omonto omokungu
0.explanation: Isaya akobwora obochania bwa omonto omokungu oreke aborete korende, akanyobocha Mesia oyo wa omokungu nigo Nyasae Omong'are na Tata wa Riere. Omonto oyo aboire ne amanywe, igo makomanyi gaigwati nigo gaberete obw’amanai n’obochania bwa Nyasae, onkare ago nimoitobia nyora oyo obokuura byoto buya obosani. Ekinyoro kia Apostolic Oneness kemerera Nyasae omwonyeni kwayoberwa omonto omokungu oyo, onkare againe baria aboirire bw’okomanyania gure bogwenene. Obochania obwo ntibwometerekerie bwerure obokaya bwose obw’ekesanane batare na omwana; bweroreta Mesia amanywe goirwe gabenzi ne Nyasae, na gukwenda bwenge obw’omoyanuru.
0.hook: Isaya amenya obochania bwa omonto omokungu na amanya ga Nyasae. Yetere, Mathayo aiboria omonto oyo aboire ne amanywe goi: Immanueli, Nyasae arya nke bunda.

1.title: Nyasae arya nabwo
1.explanation: Mathayo atora rirenga Immanueli ari goi Kristo Yesu, akamanyocha nigo 'Nyasae arya nabwo.' Eki nigo igo bwatoreta omarende moria omonto oyio nubwate ebwate bwairire Nyasae agomera amatuko. Mathayo anyorosya obochania bw’Yesu goi omwonyeni Nyasae arya nabwo abonyi b’abanto. Ekinyoro kia Apostolic Oneness kionia goi Nyasae arya kwega eng’ani ya abanto matuko. Eng'ania nigo Nyasae atoranie kwomeka’ye ekoru, ekenga, Ekristo obonye nabwo kworwate ne ememera y’abanto. Nyasae ntakosani kwomeka kwega kwomonwa omocheni; nigo aboire mondi murwa Kristo.
1.hook: Mathayo amanyorie goi Yesu Nyasae arya nabwo. Namunyanche, Yohana akonyora enyamio yere, akabereta Eri (the Word) atorie Yeso kende Nyasae.

2.title: Eri(n) nigo Nyasae
2.explanation: Yohana yabereire arekereria ebirieta bibiri: Eri (the Word) abwari kuri Nyasae, kandi Eri nigo Nyasae. Eri atari bwango ekebwati chinkoro nakwerendwa kobwatorerie obochania bwa Nyasae. Ebintu byonse ebeekarwane nobu Eri, kwonyora Kubagwe 1:3. Buo Yohana abanyobocha ritanda ria bosani: Eri uyo njenene aboire omonto esabwati ne abanto, ninsoma egotigania ebesa 14. Yesu Kristo nigo obonyora Nyasae, Eri omogorooru, eng'ani y'abanto echero.
2.hook: Yohana orwata obochania bwa Eri. Paulo kobwata orwata ogendi, akonyora ebibwati bia ching'ania mwa ogendi obwokwabere Nyasae omonda Kristo.

3.title: Nyasae mondi Kristo
3.explanation: Paulo abwire Nyasae nigo abwere omonda Kristo, obokengereria abanto semo. Goitoti, omonyoreri obochania bwoiringani ebibwate Nyasae, oyo obosani mondi n’ekorure Kristo, notorini omwenganirie Nyasae oyio ng’ania. Ebibwati ng’ani biro buosoma yengu Kristo oiwete, nogo abarati ba Kristo bareta oborete. Ekinyoro kia Apostolic Oneness kora bweroreta Nyasae kwega mondi Yesu, okoibonya ogendi okwa Kristo bwokoiosa omonto, nobose Kristo oboireta esindani bwakomo. Ebirieta nigo biyoka Nyasae orwata, ntibiasete enyama obaini oigiriria obochania.
3.hook: Nyasae nigo arwata obokengereria abanto mondi Kristo, oyonchore Kolosai ametera nonyegera ebibwate by’obosoni y’Ekironchi(tab term: Godhead) mondi Yesu.

4.title: Bosani bose bw’Ekironchi(tab term: Godhead)
4.explanation: Paulo anyorosya Kristo moreria bosani bose bw’Ekironchi(tab term: Godhead) bwari mondi omwonyeni. Ntanyora Yesu atigete ebwerai etori Nyasae kana abwate ebisaigua byairire Nyasae. N’tigo bosani bose bw’Ekironchi nigo bwari mondi Kristo abirete esindani y’abanto. Konyora kwabere Paulusa nugo akomatirira koreta ebisani ebarire ngo Yesu, notorong’ande kora abanto ogendi okuikora ebisirate se rindi Yesu. Ekinyoro kia Apostolic Oneness koinia goi Yesu Kristo Nyasae yoye, aboire mondi eng’ani y’abanto, ntakosa omonto ong’ania ekebe ka Nyasae, bosani bose nigo bwari mondi Yesu.
4.hook: Paulo anyorosya bosani bose bw’Ekironchi(tab term: Godhead) bwari mondi Kristo. Nonke, Tomasi akorota bwachamura obochania obwo.

5.title: Omwanyu wange na Nyasae wange
5.explanation: Tomasi abwata Yesu Kristo ogendi, abwira: 'Omwanyu wange na Nyasae wange.' Yohana akonyora ekoromondi kiomonto ogendi, oyo abwate Kristo aboire monsindani, noto ekoro ririkang’a. Ebibwati byonse obosoma ekonyora Yesu Kristo, omwana wa Nyasae, noboreta obwenge bwaswe ekegenderania komanya Yesu. Ekinyoro kia Apostolic Oneness kimenyete bwachamura obwo bwariete: Nyasae wa Abaisiraeli amanyirie mondi Yesu, aboire korwa Tomasi ogendi abeng’ania bwose.
5.hook: Tomasi abwata Yesu omogendi, amanyorie Omwanyu wange na Nyasae wange. Eng'ania egendererete etekereria ritanda ririkang’a: Eri oyo abwari Nyasae aboire mondi eng'ani.
